questions.q: Why did the U.S. Dollar Index climb back above 100?
o: Because the Federal Reserve issued hawkish signals that increased expectations for further rate hikes.
Because the Bank of England lowered its benchmark interest rates significantly.
Because U.S. Treasury yields compressed following a loss by Jane Street.
